At just 28, Anupam Kher made his film debut playing a 65-year-old retired professor mourning the murder of his only son in Mahesh Bhatt’s Saaransh (1984). As B.V. Pradhan, Kher portrayed a father struggling with grief, questioning religion, faith and society while trying to find a reason to live. The performance broke away from conventional Bollywood hero roles and laid the foundation for his nearly five-decade-long career.
